# Science News Explores

> A STEM news magazine for middle school readers and up covering all fields of science through accessible, age-appropriate articles.

Science News Explores publishes science journalism across life sciences, earth sciences, health, psychology, and more. The site is organized by topic archives, making it easy for young readers to explore specific areas of scientific interest.

## Key Topics

- science-education
- science-news
- climate-science
- ecosystems
- neuroscience
- animal-behavior
- ocean-ecology
- paleontology
- climate-change
- seaweed-blooms

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://www.snexplores.org): Homepage for Science News Explores science news magazine for middle school readers and up.
- [Magazine](https://www.snexplores.org/magazine): Magazine introduction for Science News Explores STEM publication for ages 9+.
- [Topics Directory](https://www.snexplores.org/topics): Topic directory and content hub for browsing Science News Explores articles.

## Life Sciences

- [Life](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/life): Archive of life sciences articles covering animals, oceans, and ecosystems.
- [Animals](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/animals): Archive of animal science articles on behavior, cognition, and evolution.
- [Brain](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/brain): Archive of neuroscience articles on brain research and adolescent development.
- [Plants](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/plants): Archive of plant science articles on botany, pollination, and climate.
- [Microbes](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/microbes): Archive of microbiology articles on microbes and microbial research.
- [Genetics](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/genetics): Archive of genetics articles on ancient DNA and genetic engineering.

## Earth & Environment Sciences

- [Earth](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/earth): Archive of earth science articles on agriculture, oceans, and climate.
- [Environment](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/environment): Archive of environmental science articles on climate change and ecosystems.
- [Climate](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/climate): Archive of climate science articles on environmental change and ecology.
- [Oceans](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/oceans): Archive of ocean science articles on marine life and seaweed blooms.
- [Ecosystems](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/ecosystems): Archive of ecosystem science covering ocean ecology and species conservation.
- [Agriculture](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/agriculture): Archive of agriculture articles on farm technology and sustainable farming.

## Human Sciences

- [Humans](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/humans): Archive of human biology articles on health, brain development, and medicine.
- [Health & Medicine](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/health-medicine): Archive of medical science articles on disease research and youth health.
- [Psychology](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/psychology): Archive of psychology articles on adolescence, emotions, and neuroscience.

## History & Origins

- [Fossils](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/fossils): Archive of paleontology articles on dinosaurs and fossil discoveries.
- [Archaeology](https://www.snexplores.org/topic/archaeology): Archive of archaeology articles on ancient history and Neandertal discoveries.
